It took us almost a year (yes, a YEAR) to transition our furry drama queens – Homer, Simba, and Eva – from junk food to fresh food. At first, it was full-scale rebellion: dramatic food rejections, passive-aggressive hunger strikes, and more side-eye than a reality show reunion. But we stuck with it. Marcus Hough and I went from being ignored at mealtime to now having our brats do zoomies of joy when dinner arrives.

Yes, freshly cooked pet food costs a bit more, but so does kombucha, and this actually works. Their gut health, fur coats, digestion, immunity – everything's better.

The hardest part? Breaking their addiction to those chemical-laden wet pouches. It's like trying to get a toddler off sugar. But trust me, don’t give up. Just like us, pets don't always like healthy things at first – but in the long run, everyone feels better. Including your vet bill.

Big love and a loud purr of thanks to Varun Jethwani for running The Pet Pantry like a true superhero in an apron. Homer, Simba, and Eva may never write thank-you notes, but they lick their bowls clean every single time – which is basically a standing ovation in pet language.
